test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Instead of dividing ₹3,910 among P, Q and R in the ratio (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8), by mistake it was divided in the ratio 4 : 5 : 8. By how much did R gain in this transaction?
solution:
Given: 

Sum to be divided = Rs. 3910

Right ratio = (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

Wrong ratio = 4 : 5 : 8

Concept used:

Ratio Proportion

Calculation:

Mentioned right ratio 

⇒ (1)/(4):(1)/(5):(1)/(8)

⇒(1/4 × 40) : (1/5 × 40) : (1/8 × 40)

⇒ 10 : 8 : 5

Correct share of R = 5/(10 + 8 + 5) × 3910 = Rs. 850

Share that R got because of the mistake = 8/(4 + 5 + 8) × 3910 = Rs. 1840

Gain of R = (1840 - 850) = Rs. 990

**∴ By Rs. 990 R gained in this transaction. **
